dedupe_keys.name: leveraging directivity of wind farm noise to increase profitability

description: Shah, Anik and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. A modelled three-by-four layout uses twelve IEA 3.4 MW reference turbines and a real site relationship to a nearby settlement. The analysis considers directional turbine noise while respecting reception-point limits and reports about two percent annual energy gain under its assumptions. Wind-direction and noise-model uncertainties are examined. The turbines and control strategy are simulation choices, not verified installed assets. Directivity-aware gains depend on the relative layout, settlement location and dominant wind direction. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. This record represents the documented application and its stated scope. Publication access does not imply that its underlying measurements or implementation are public. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance. The control appraisal is based on a real site represented with reference turbines.
